themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, conduct analysis, or execute complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, or optimize code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Research and discussions around AI-generated content, voices, images, or data that mimics human interaction or characteristics.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and analyses on the behavior, capabilities, risks, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Content covering specific AI-powered software and platforms designed to assist in various research activities.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is used to inform, assist, or automate aspects of the design process for user interfaces and experiences.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is integrated into the testing and evaluation of product usability and user experience.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis on how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills, and the broader labor market.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Content focused on using AI to gather, analyze, and derive insights from customer data and feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
